verdict.rationale: Numeral's docs confirm it manages filings and remittance end-to-end ("Register, file, and remit... on time, every time", MCP tools surfacing filings and nexus status) but there is no evidence of a calendar-style upcoming-returns view, no mention of remitted amounts display, and no mention of downloadable confirmations for submitted returns. missing for 10: calendar view of upcoming filings, remitted-amount reporting per filing, downloadable filing confirmations.
